wrapper.contents:
import io, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tarfile, tempfile
revision = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cicd-3-5-provenance-baseline-') as directory:
    baseline = pathlib.Path(directory)
    archive = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'archive', revision, '.github', 'Github', 'Tools'])
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive)) as files:
        files.extractall(baseline, filter='data')
    print('Baseline revision: ' + revision, flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(subprocess.call([sys.executable, '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', str(baseline / 'Github/governed-provenance/tests'), '-p', 'test_governed_provenance.py', '-v'], cwd=baseline))
